hypothesis: Injecting few-shot exemplars retrieved from the full 619-pair corpus into the champion adapter's prompt should push quality above the adapter-only plateau, because richer in-context examples give the model concrete surface-form guidance it can't get from weights alone.
technique: RAG retrieval from the full 619-pair bank is used to select nearest exemplars, which are injected as few-shot context into a single greedy on-device call on the champion LoRA adapter — replicating exp032's idea but fixing the leakage so eval cases are genuinely held out.
result: Scored 0.405 on the full-30 gate (3 wins / 2 ties / 24 losses vs Sonnet); rubric shows atom=4, spec=4, cover=3, nat=4, nonRed=3 — coverage remains the stubborn weak spot. The honest non-leaking version of exp032 confirmed that the RAG boost in exp032 was artefactual; this run was discarded.
